item.tib: mkha' 'gro grib sel tshe dbang rtog 'joms kyi cha lag zur 'deg za ma tog
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul ni g+har rigs kyi btsun pa sa trig tshul min gyis (mi yis) nye bar nan bskul lha bu spa las mdzes pa'i grub rig 'chang po nyi ma 'bum gsal 'bod pa de yis bris sbyang ri dmar bde ldan khrod du/ dge sbyor grub pa'i thun mtshams su bris pas/ 'gro rnams rtog 'dzin rang grol bde chen mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
